title: APH State Funding Priority Model
description: Canonical configuration for a state aviation funding priority model. Round-trips Wyoming, MnDOT, ALDOT, Louisiana, and the six ACRP Synthesis 123 case examples.

decisions_log.description: Append-only log of design decisions for auditability.

eligibility_gate.description: Optional pre-scoring eligibility filter (Louisiana pattern). Projects failing the gate are excluded from ranking.

weighting_model.description: How criterion scores are combined. multiplicative: sum of (criterion.weight * subcategory.score) — Wyoming. additive_100pt: sum of capped per-criterion points — MnDOT, ALDOT. formula: arbitrary expression evaluated over criterion scores — Illinois. dual_objective_subjective: objective scoring + subjective override layer — North Dakota.

global_formula.description: Required when weighting_model = formula. Safe expression syntax referencing criterion ids, e.g. '(4*A + 2*C + 0.7*P + 0.7*T)/4.2 + X'. Evaluated with ast-based safe evaluator, never raw eval().

set_asides.description: Funding portions reserved for specific project categories before ranking is applied.

adjustments.description: Optional score adjustments applied after base scoring.

revenue_producing_bump.description: Bonus for projects that don't compete well for FAA funds (~33% of states use this per ACRP).

low_federal_priority_bonus.description: Illinois pattern: bonus when FAA NPRS score falls below threshold.

tradeoff_layer.description: North Dakota pattern: post-scoring sequencing rules.

decision_authority.description: Who has final approval (e.g., 'Wyoming Aeronautics Commission').

model_review_cycle_years.description: How often the model itself is reviewed and re-approved.

scoring_authority.description: Who computes the scores (typically division staff).

approval_process.description: Plain-language description of the path from scoring to final approval.

weight.description: Required when weighting_model = multiplicative. Multiplied with the selected subcategory score.

max_points.description: Required when weighting_model = additive_100pt. The cap for this criterion.

bucket.description: Optional grouping label (e.g., 'System Plan Alignment' for MnDOT's 60-pt bucket).

project_field.description: Project field/column the engine consults to resolve a subcategory match. If absent, defaults to the criterion id. Subcategory-level field_match overrides this.

acrp_category.description: Mapping to ACRP Synthesis 123 14-criterion taxonomy (extended with system_plan_alignment which appears in every state model).

scoring_style.description: How this criterion produces a score. select_one: pick one subcategory. select_many: sum of selected subcategory scores. tiered_score: pick the matching tier (with possible negative scores). flat_lookup: project field maps to a fixed score (ALDOT project-type table). accumulating: sum of all qualifying subcategories up to max_points (Wyoming Airport Protection). formula: per-criterion expression.

external_metric_source.description: Optional URL or system reference for live data (e.g., 'https://mnsasp-mndot.hub.arcgis.com/' for MnDOT's MnSASP Hub).

negative_scores_allowed.description: Set true for criteria like MnDOT's compliance scoring where non-compliance subtracts.

condition.description: Plain-language match condition (e.g., 'Project clears Part 77 obstructions').

field_match.description: Structured match against project fields. Optional; if present, engine can auto-select.

eligibility_filter.description: Plain-language rule for which projects are eligible for this set-aside.
